id.description: Unique identifier for this webhook event

integration_tool.description: The name of the integrated tool (e.g., "personio", "greenhouse").

integration_id.description: The unique identifier of the integration.

integration_category.description: The category of the integration (HRIS, ATS, ASSESSMENT, or LMS).

organization_name.description: The name of the organization that owns the integration.

creator_email.description: The email address of the user who created the integration.

origin_id.description: The unique identifier of the organization in the integrated system.

end_user.description: Information about the end user who created the integration.

qa_status.description: The quality assurance status of the integration.

setup_status.description: The current status of an integration that has filtering, field mapping features or required setup steps.

state.description: The current state of the integration.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the integration state was last updated.
